purpose: Paired exploratory prompt comparison across original styles; not a generator ranking or complete skill evaluation

challenger.append:
Small-display construction priorities:
Establish one dominant outer mass and the few secondary forms needed to identify this exact subject. Give the meaning-bearing feature more visual area than decorative features, using only the specified style and palette.
Keep small gaps between important forms visibly open after reduction to 24 px. Consolidate ornamental texture, tiny facets, scales and redundant highlights into broad surfaces. Do not remove anatomy or features needed to distinguish the requested meaning.
Keep attached shadows restrained within the subject's footprint. Preserve clean alpha at the contour without a colored matte, floating shadow or background plate. Do not use a border or an unrequested outline to compensate for poor contrast.
At small sizes, preserve the specified expression, gesture and subject before adding surface detail. Return the same original visual system, not a different subject or style.

styles.description: Original soft geometric 3D emoji with broad rounded masses; saturated but restrained subject-appropriate colors; matte ceramic surfaces; readable large features
styles.perspective: front three-quarter; faces and gestures remain readable
styles.lighting: one broad soft upper-left key light; no detached cast shadow
styles.detailLevel: low to medium; prioritize identifying forms
styles.accentPolicy: one subject-appropriate accent; no extra decorative color spots

styles.description: Original flat vector-like emoji with broad rounded filled shapes, clear negative spaces and a compact subject-appropriate palette; no gradients or texture
styles.perspective: near frontal; only use overlap needed to identify the subject
styles.lighting: flat fills with a single broad secondary shade where needed
styles.accentPolicy: at most three main colors; preserve semantic color distinctions

styles.description: Original dark graphite 3D emoji with broad smooth surfaces, restrained silver highlights and a single violet accent; avoid fine engravings, black-on-black microdetail or neon outlines
styles.perspective: front three-quarter; preserve readable face and gesture features
styles.lighting: broad upper-left light that separates major forms; no luminous outline or detached shadow
styles.detailLevel: low to medium; emphasize silhouette and identifying features
styles.accentPolicy: one restrained violet accent; highlights remain broad and neutral

cases.label: Happy face
cases.subject: One clearly happy face with smiling eyes and an open smile
cases.criticalFeature: Happy expression, distinct from sadness or anger

cases.label: Sad crying face
cases.subject: One sad face with a downturned mouth and one visible tear
cases.criticalFeature: Sadness and a readable tear; not tears of joy

cases.label: Thumbs up
cases.subject: One anatomically coherent hand giving a clear thumbs-up gesture
cases.criticalFeature: Upward thumb clearly separated from the curled fingers

cases.label: Victory hand
cases.subject: One anatomically coherent hand with two fingers raised in a V gesture
cases.criticalFeature: Two distinct raised fingers with an open V gap

cases.label: Rocket
cases.subject: One compact rocket with a distinct nose, body, fins and attached exhaust flame
cases.criticalFeature: Rocket profile with readable fins and exhaust

cases.label: Closed padlock
cases.subject: One closed padlock with a curved shackle and a solid lock body
cases.criticalFeature: Closed shackle; not an unlocked padlock

cases.label: Gear
cases.subject: One gear with a small number of broad readable teeth and a central hole

cases.label: Magnifying glass
cases.subject: One magnifying glass with a large readable circular lens and a single attached handle

cases.label: Heart
cases.subject: One symmetrical heart with two distinct upper lobes and a pointed lower tip
cases.criticalFeature: Heart contour; no text or decorative ornaments

cases.label: Shield
cases.subject: One compact shield with a broad upper edge and a pointed lower silhouette
cases.criticalFeature: Shield silhouette without a badge or background plate

cases.label: Octopus
cases.subject: One compact octopus with a distinct head and a readable arrangement of eight arms; simplify suckers and surface texture
cases.criticalFeature: Octopus head and arms remain readable rather than becoming a tangled mass

cases.label: Dragon
cases.subject: One compact full-body dragon with a readable horned head, limbs and curled tail; simplify scales and small spikes
cases.criticalFeature: Dragon head and full-body silhouette, not a snake or an indistinct curl
